author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/08/2019: GSUM, MEET, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.02%
AAPL: +0.65%
IBM: +1.06%
CSCO: +0.81%
GOOG: +0.59%
Technology stocks were advancing pre-bell Tuesday.
Early movers include:
(+) The Meet Group ( MEET ) was up more than 8% after it pegged Q4 revenue of approximately $52.3 million, above the high end of its prior outlook of $47.8 million to $48.8 million and exceeding the Street projection of $49.8 million.
In other sector news:
(+) International Business Machines ( IBM ) was over 1% higher after it signed a multi-year managed services agreement valued at $540 million with Helsinki-based Nordea Bank.
(=) Gridsum Holding ( GSUM ) was notified by Nasdaq about its non-compliance with the continued listing requirement of timely filing on form 6-K of its interim balance sheet and income statement for the six month period ended June 30.
